reports.title: Spilsbury Holdings Ltd Audit Results (AUD461) - Barretenberg
reports.description: Sentnl differential-fuzzing audit of the Barretenberg C++ cryptographic library (native uint256/uintx arithmetic, BN254/secp256k1/secp256r1 curve operations, ECDSA verification) compared against Botan, libff and libsecp256k1. It reports memory bugs, incorrect arithmetic results and invalid-point handling issues without assigning per-finding severities.
